title: Vanishing of cohomology from the vanishing of Cech cohomology over a cofinal collection of coverings
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: The lemma gives a vanishing criterion for the cohomology of an abelian sheaf on a site in terms of the vanishing of Cech cohomology for a collection of coverings which is cofinal in each object of a subset B (statement lines 1564-1585). The proof first replaces cohomology by the Cech cohomology of that collection, using cofinality (proof lines 1587-1619), and then handles the general degree by embedding the sheaf into an injective, applying the long exact cohomology sequence and using the induction hypothesis (proof lines 1622-1647). The non-formal content is the reduction to the Cech computation together with the degree induction. The claim is H2: two steps, both written out, and the statement is explicitly marked by the author as a variant of a known result.
